# Work-item dependency graph

> Derived from `../backlog.yaml`. Do not edit this file manually.

## Status

- 🟩 **Completed** — accepted work.
- 🟦 **In Progress** — currently executing.
- 🟨 **Ready** — pending work with all dependencies satisfied.
- 🟥 **Blocked** — pending work with at least one incomplete work-item dependency.

```mermaid
%%{init: {'flowchart': {'curve': 'linear', 'nodeSpacing': 32, 'rankSpacing': 54}} }%%
flowchart TD
  W001["W001<br/>Foundation"]
  W002["W002<br/>API"]
  W003["W003<br/>UI"]
  W004["W004<br/>Integration"]
  W005["W005<br/>Blocked source"]
  W006["W006<br/>Blocked target"]

  W001 --> W002
  W001 --> W003
  W001 --> W004
  W002 --> W004
  W003 --> W004
  W004 --> W005
  W005 --> W006

  linkStyle 0 stroke:#16a34a,stroke-width:2px;
  linkStyle 1 stroke:#16a34a,stroke-width:2px;
  linkStyle 2 stroke:#16a34a,stroke-width:2px;
  linkStyle 3 stroke:#2563eb,stroke-width:3px;
  linkStyle 4 stroke:#d97706,stroke-width:2px,stroke-dasharray:6 4;
  linkStyle 5 stroke:#dc2626,stroke-width:2px,stroke-dasharray:2 3;
  linkStyle 6 stroke:#dc2626,stroke-width:2px,stroke-dasharray:2 3;

  classDef completed fill:#dcfce7,stroke:#16a34a,color:#14532d;
  classDef in_progress fill:#dbeafe,stroke:#2563eb,color:#1e3a8a;
  classDef ready fill:#fef3c7,stroke:#d97706,color:#78350f;
  classDef blocked fill:#fee2e2,stroke:#dc2626,color:#7f1d1d;
  class W001 completed;
  class W002 in_progress;
  class W003 ready;
  class W004,W005,W006 blocked;
```

Dependency arrows are authoritative for execution ordering. Flow executes one mutating task at a time; independent read-only research or review may run in parallel.
